name: Mystic Forge
oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.
{T}, Pay 1 life: Exile the top card of your library.
blocked_sentences: You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.

needs.what: the `colorless` key (zero colours, 105.2c) admitted in a cast_from_library_top static's `affects_spells` filter, so the colorless half of "artifact spells and colorless spells" can be written as a second permission beside the {"types": ["Artifact"]} one (or `any_of` over the two branches)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_library_top's affects_spells is checked against LIBRARY_TOP_CAST_FILTER_KEYS (SPELL_FILTER_KEYS minus controller, plus power/toughness), which has no `colorless` and no `any_of`; `colors` is a membership test that cannot say zero colours, and `not_types`/`min_colors` cannot either. characteristics._matches_printed already honours `colorless`, so only the loader whitelist blocks it. Writing only the Artifact half would silently drop every colorless nonartifact spell (Eldrazi, Kozilek's Return-style colorless cards).
